subject: Aligning VP/CTO presence for Tiffinram demo — availability and recording preference
messages:
From: Mark Goldstein <mark.goldstein@tiffinram.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@tiffinram.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync — executive presence for next-week demo

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick product overview last week. We want to move to a live demo w/ our leadership team next week and aim to have our VP of Product (Asha) and CTO on the call. Before I lock time with them I wanted to confirm:

- What level of technical depth do you recommend for the CTO? (architecture + perf numbers?)
- Can Redwood commit a VP or senior engineering presence for the first 30 minutes?

We are roughly thinking June 3–4 between 10–14 PT. If that window doesn’t work we can offer June 7. Also: we prefer no recordings for the first session due to IP sensitivity unless Redwood signs an NDA rider — is that something you can accept?

I attached a one-page brief with our goals.

Best,
Mark

[Attachment: Tiffinram-demo-brief-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick sync — executive presence for next-week demo

Hi Mark — thanks for the note and the brief. Great context.

Short answers up front:
- CTO depth: yes — we suggest a 20–25 minute tech-deep segment covering model choices, latency SLOs, and data isolation options (VPC/private deployment) plus a brief Q&A.
- Redwood senior presence: I can confirm a senior engineering lead (Ben Carter, Head of Field Engineering) for the session and either Lauren or one of our product VPs on the executive intro. I’ve CC’d Lauren and Ben to confirm headcount.
- Recording / NDA: We can respect the request. If you’d like a non-recorded session we’ll mark it private in the invite. If procurement needs an NDA rider to be signed before the demo, please send it and I’ll loop Legal.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Jun 3: 10:00–10:45 or 13:00–13:45
- Fri Jun 4: 11:00–11:45
- Backup: Mon Jun 7: 10:30–11:15

If you can confirm Asha + CTO availability for one of those, I will send a calendar hold and a short agenda. Also including a draft mutual action plan for scope / procurement items.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri y o m.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: MutualActionPlan_TFF-3479.xlsx (Excel)]

Subject: Re: Quick sync — executive presence for next-week demo

Priyom / Lauren — I can take the CTO deep-dive. Outline I plan to cover (20–25m):

1) High-level architecture and where inference runs (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private)
2) Latency & throughput profiles we’ve seen with similar batch sizes + kernel/quantization tradeoffs
3) Security controls: VPC, KMS, audit logs, SOC2 artifacts and how we isolate customer keys
4) Short Q&A + next steps (rollout / procurement checkpoints)

If they confirm no recording, I’ll make sure we don’t start the recording and I’ll avoid showing any customer-specific slides.

Also, if procurement wants a pre-demo checklist I can fill the SOC2 artifact list; CC’d Mark so he knows.

—Ben

- We will not allow recording for this session; we’ll share a redacted follow-up if needed.
- I attached a short procurement note; procurement will need a DocuSign link for the NDA before the next technical deep-dive if we proceed.
- Agenda ask: 10 min exec intro (Lauren or a VP), 25 min CTO deep-dive (Ben), 10 min wrap + next steps.

Would you send a calendar invite with the non-recording flag and the confirmed agenda? Also, please add the HubSpot deal link to the invite so procurement can reference it.

Thanks — looking forward.
Mark
